source_text.body:
Track AI startups with an agent
A commenter used Manus to track AI startups and says it did a great job, though one task got out of hand near the end of their subscription and they got some credits back.
Done with
MA
Manus
What they did
Chintan Zalani used Manus for a month to track AI startups. He used its knowledge feature to set standing instructions, including ones for saving credits. Manus then built a plan from whatever he asked for. Near the end of his subscription, one task kept running after he gave a wrong instruction. He asked it to stop several times and it didn't.
How it went
He says Manus did the tracking well, was quick and economical with credits, and beat Operator. The runaway task cost over 2k credits. After he contacted support, some credits were refunded.
Worth knowing
Set credit-saving instructions in the knowledge feature, and contact support quickly if a task runs away, because Manus refunded some credits.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
Research [topic, e.g. AI startups in healthcare] and build a tracker spreadsheet with company name, what it does, funding raised, latest news, and a source link for each. Look for entries from [time period, e.g. the last 30 days] and keep the scope to about [number] companies so the task stays bounded. Stop once the sheet is complete and give me a short summary of the notable changes.
Original source: https://aiblewmymind.substack.com/p/how-manus-ai-helped-me-create-a-318/comments
